status: rejected after independent tuning confirmation; active champion unchanged
hypothesis: The existing pearl-cluster bonus uses toroidal geometric distance even when kelp disconnects a visible cluster. Restricting it to the proposed move's traversable visible component could avoid steering toward unreachable food without changing the broader collection policy.

mode_1.description: Ignore cluster centres and member pearls outside the candidate move's reachable visible component; retain geometric approach distance.
mode_1.instability: Schooltime was 0-2 in the screen; Big Empty was 0-2 in confirmation.

mode_2.description: Mode 1 plus graph-route rather than geometric approach distance.
mode_2.instability: Default Small and Schooltime were 0-2 in the screen; Colosseum and Default were 0-2 in confirmation.

decision: Both modes screened 10-6, but neither repeated that result: mode 1 confirmed at 9-7 and mode 2 at 8-8. Their map-level gains and regressions also reversed between seeds. Neither was frozen for an all-map gate, diverse opponents or sandbox execution.

verification.screen_check_records: passed: 32 complete unique valid fault-free games
verification.confirmation_check_records: passed: 32 complete unique valid fault-free games
verification.smoke_test: passed: isolated visible pearls receive zero graph-aware cluster value
